quality_boundaries: Promoted facts must come from official primary sources with stable evidence locators.
Unpublished, unavailable, historical-only, draft, and unresolved facts must remain explicit.
No Jichi Insight policy-achievement score, causal attribution, or unverified cross-city ranking may be created.
This candidate is machine-prepared evidence only and is not Reviewed until a person checks the primary sources.

human_review.boundary: A person must check the candidate against the cited primary sources before any promotion to reviewed_complete.

publication.boundary: Candidate data is staging-only and must not be loaded by the public site or treated as reviewed data.
